scope: Complete standard original 2017 core game on balanced maps, normal Blight Cards and solo, with supplied rulebook-linked Living FAQ core corrections. No adversaries/scenarios/thematic maps/optional difficulty/performance scoring/expansion mechanics assessed as required content. Individual cards and Spirit panels retain their own text and exceptions.
summary: No material gameplay error found in the audited candidate. Setup-only +1 Blight and action-tree outcome corrections are accurately applied. One harmless component-inventory omission remains; all essential procedures and included card/Spirit clarifications checked against the permitted evidence.

findings.claim: The paragraph enumerates the base-box contents but omits the Invader Board and the 20 Fear markers.

source_reference.evidence: Component list explicitly includes INVADER BOARD and 20 FEAR MARKERS.

findings.impact: Does not prevent play: the rest of the summary supplies the Fear-pool setup count and uses the Invader Board. It leaves the presented box inventory incomplete.
findings.proposed_correction: Include 1 Invader Board and 20 Fear markers in the Components inventory.

checked_claims.claims: Scope, cooperative goal, player count, duration, original base contents
checked_claims.detail: All stated counts checked; component-list omission is finding F1.

checked_claims.claims: Piece Health, outgoing Ravage Damage, automatic Town/City Fear
checked_claims.detail: Explorer 1/1/0; Town 2/2/1; City 3/3/2; Dahan 2/2. Damage does not reduce outgoing Damage.

checked_claims.claims: Unlimited Invader and Dahan supplies, stacking, finite Presence
checked_claims.detail: Correct; substitutes permitted; one Sacred Site per land despite a larger stack.

checked_claims.claims: Random balanced boards, printed setup pieces and board layouts
checked_claims.detail: Correct standard layout references; two-board bottom-to-bottom description matches FAQ. Setup Blight comes from box.

checked_claims.claims: Invader deck stage randomization, unseen removal, 3/4/5 stack
checked_claims.detail: Correct 12-card deck; one of each stage removed unseen.

checked_claims.claims: Fear pool and deck setup
checked_claims.detail: Correct 4 Fear per Spirit and 3/3/3 Fear Card groups with Terror dividers.

checked_claims.claims: Healthy initial Blight pool and setup-only +1
checked_claims.detail: Correct 2 per Spirit plus 1 total, never repeat +1 upon flipping.

checked_claims.claims: Minor/Major supplies and Spirit starting hand and tracks
checked_claims.detail: Correct separately shuffled decks, 13 Presence, four Unique cards, leftmost solid spaces uncovered.

checked_claims.claims: Setup choices, overlapping placement instructions, initial Explore
checked_claims.detail: Correct; initial Explore final setup step, then its card goes to Build.

checked_claims.claims: Introductory low-complexity Spirits, Power Progressions, no-card Blight pool
checked_claims.source_reference: CORE pp.3,6,18; Core FAQ .9v5kavp; Setup FAQ one-more-blight-errata
checked_claims.detail: Correct teaching alternatives; Major Forget still applies; no-card pool 5 per Spirit +1.

checked_claims.claims: Simultaneous play, individual Spirit Phase order, no early Fast resolution
checked_claims.detail: Correct Growth → Energy → play/pay for each Spirit; all finish before Fast.

checked_claims.claims: Growth mandatory instructions, any order, impossible portions and costs
checked_claims.detail: Correct; explicit costs paid fully; Green multi-option instructions may interleave.

checked_claims.claims: Add Presence tracks, sequential placements, reposition source and destination
checked_claims.detail: Correct leftmost disk from either track; may use island disk even with track disks remaining; choose legal destination before picking it up.

checked_claims.claims: Move Presence versus Add/reposition and Gather/Push Presence
checked_claims.detail: Correct distinction and mandatory effects where possible; up-to movement can be zero.

checked_claims.claims: Income, card-play limits, payment timing and carryover
checked_claims.detail: Correct highest uncovered numbers, no summing, individual resources; no spending future Fast income in Spirit Phase.

checked_claims.claims: Reclaim, Reclaim One and continuous/flexible track Elements
checked_claims.detail: Correct personal-discard destinations and once-per-Spirit-Phase timing; flexible action Elements chosen immediately.

checked_claims.claims: Fast and Slow Power ordering and skipping whole Powers
checked_claims.detail: Correct no interruption, no Energy refund, no delaying a Fast Power until Slow.

checked_claims.claims: Invader Phase and advance-card sequence
checked_claims.detail: Correct Blighted/Fear/Ravage/Build/Explore/advance order; empty action slots do nothing.

checked_claims.claims: Earned Fear Card stack ordering, current Terror Level and new cards during Fear
checked_claims.detail: Correct order earned, no looking ahead, new cards append and resolve in same Fear step.

checked_claims.claims: Invader card affected lands, Coastal card, Stage III and ignored flags
checked_claims.detail: Correct; two terrain orders may interleave.

checked_claims.claims: Snapshot eligibility before resolving a card and newly moved Invaders
checked_claims.detail: Correct; no new lands added mid-card; new Invaders join Ravage in an already queued land.

checked_claims.claims: Ravage simultaneous land/Dahan Damage, efficient allocation and Blight threshold
checked_claims.detail: Correct standard Damage, 2+ adds exactly one Blight; Dahan do not absorb land Damage.

checked_claims.claims: Dahan counterattack, zero Damage, skipped Ravage and early timing replacement
checked_claims.detail: Correct; survivors deal 2 each, even damaged; early attack substitutes rather than adding another attack.

checked_claims.claims: Build building selection and no upgrade
checked_claims.detail: Correct more Towns than Cities builds City, otherwise Town; needs Invaders for a normal Build Card.

checked_claims.claims: Explore sources, one Explorer per land, supply origin and skipped neighboring actions
checked_claims.detail: Correct Town/City in or adjacent, or Ocean adjacent; Explorers not sources.

checked_claims.claims: Time Passes destinations and duration
checked_claims.detail: Correct cards to personal discard, Damage and card Elements clear, temporary effects end, Energy and board changes persist.

checked_claims.claims: Innates, non-spent Elements and using all thresholds on one target
checked_claims.detail: Correct one use and one target unless specified; fewer Elements choice applies consistently to the Power.

checked_claims.claims: Power range/origin/target restrictions and target-at-use timing
checked_claims.detail: Correct numeric range versus source/target conditions; legal targets can yield no effect.

checked_claims.claims: Instruction order, optionality, or-clauses and mid-Power Element changes
checked_claims.detail: Correct do-as-much-as-possible, mandatory instructions after starting, and threshold checks at relevant times.

checked_claims.claims: Gain Power draw/keep/discard, reshuffle, unlimited hand and card visibility
checked_claims.detail: Correct choose deck, draw four, keep one, shared deck discard for remainder.

checked_claims.claims: Major Forget requirements, possible locations and Unique/shared destinations
checked_claims.detail: Correct may Forget newly gained Major or card in play; in-play Elements and unused use lost; resolved effects remain.

checked_claims.claims: Major gains versus gifts/transfers/taking and extra-play effects
checked_claims.detail: Correct transferred Major does not require Forget; genuine gain does; extra plays exceed track count and resolve at appropriate speed.

checked_claims.claims: Damage allocation, accumulation, Health changes and destination of destruction
checked_claims.detail: Correct Damage generally means Invader Damage, immediate destruction at Health, and destination-land destruction on movement.

checked_claims.claims: Destroy versus Remove versus Replace and retained Damage
checked_claims.detail: Correct ordinary replacement no Fear, but carried Damage may destroy replacement and earn Fear.

checked_claims.claims: Defend independent protection of land and Dahan and additive values
checked_claims.detail: Correct per occurrence, minimum zero, simultaneous protection preserved when Earth site is lost to same Ravage.

checked_claims.claims: Gather/Push count, distance, legal destinations, adjacency and self-movement
checked_claims.detail: Correct adjacency-required Gather/Push cannot act within same land, unlike unrestricted Move.

checked_claims.claims: Repeat rules, retained modifiers, current speed and explicit timing/location
checked_claims.source_reference: CORE p.19; Core FAQ .9v5kfgr, repeating-powers-with-changed-speeds, timing-of-choosing-powers-for-once-this-turn-repeats, Repeating-internal-range-boosts
checked_claims.detail: Correct choose Repeat card later, no extra printed Elements, no extra card play, threshold recheck, location overrides target restrictions.

checked_claims.claims: Repeat prevention of chains and Powerstorm/Gift of Strength limitations
checked_claims.detail: Correct repeated Repeat text ignored; non-Repeat effects remain; repeats cards rather than Innates and Powerstorm cards must differ.

checked_claims.claims: Terror victory conditions and all standard defeat routes
checked_claims.detail: Correct I/II/III requirements, final Fear card earns victory without resolution; last existing Invader card is not itself a loss.

checked_claims.claims: Action-tree victory/defeat checks and sacrifice wins
checked_claims.detail: Correct finish single-land Ravage, cascades, counterattack and triggered actions; check before next independent action, including next Ravage land.

checked_claims.claims: Geography, your lands, Sacred Sites and destroyed Presence
checked_claims.detail: Correct corner adjacency, cliffs versus coast, Ocean normally out of play, own disks for Sacred Sites and no harm from merely entering existing Blight.

checked_claims.claims: Blight pool destinations, Presence loss, cascade amount and revisits
checked_claims.detail: Correct one Presence per Spirit per addition event, one adjacent cascade, original land also receives Blight; removed Blight goes to current face-up pool.

checked_claims.claims: Healthy exhaustion, simultaneous additions exceeding pool and flipped-card timing
checked_claims.source_reference: CORE p.15; Core FAQ .9v5kfqt, .7w4g8r7; Setup FAQ one-more-blight-errata
checked_claims.detail: Correct immediate flip effects are nested; old unused Blight carried into new pool; no repeated setup +1; no return to Healthy.

checked_claims.claims: Fear generation, carryover and Terror divider exposure
checked_claims.detail: Correct island-wide marker movement, earned cards face-down and overflow carried forward.

checked_claims.claims: Fear card each-player choices, shared Presence tests and action grouping
checked_claims.detail: Correct individual sequential choices unrestricted by own Presence, repeated piece choices allowed unless prohibited, mixed effects one action tree.

checked_claims.claims: Health-worth removal allowances
checked_claims.detail: Correct total within single action but no pooling between each-player actions.

checked_claims.claims: Solo target exception, multi-handed scaling and decision ownership
checked_claims.source_reference: CORE pp.8,22; Core FAQ .bu6og25; Setup FAQ Can-one-person-play-more-than-one-Spirit
checked_claims.detail: Correct another-Spirit self targeting only for one Spirit; no other-Spirit conditional bonuses; decisions and ties correctly assigned.

checked_claims.claims: Changing-content checks and Encompassing Ward
checked_claims.detail: Correct local effects fixed on resolution, whole-class effects check relevant current contents.

checked_claims.claims: Self-modifying Innates and triggered-action timing/recursion
checked_claims.detail: Correct; Vengeance corrected base text includes 3 Fear and delayed Damage per destroyed Town/City/Dahan, not per individual instruction.

checked_claims.claims: Dahan Raid/Enheartened, Trade Suffers, Overseas Trade Seems Safer, Scapegoats
checked_claims.detail: All included corrected effects and action groupings checked.

checked_claims.claims: Crops Wither and Fade, Veil the Night’s Hunt, total Damage boosts and attribution
checked_claims.detail: Correct Fear before choice, spread to distinct Invaders, overall extra Damage and original source attribution.

checked_claims.claims: Song of Sanctity, Dissolve the Bonds, Poisoned Land and Tsunami
checked_claims.detail: Correct Slow speed, missing Explorer symbol, simultaneous mutual Damage, newly added Blight counted and Fear per other affected Coastal land.

checked_claims.claims: Wrap in Wings, Blazing Renewal, Trees and Stones and Infinite Vitality
checked_claims.detail: Correct moved-to location requirement, real restored Presence prerequisite, Defend follows that Power’s moved Dahan only and Remove/Replace not protected.

checked_claims.claims: Entwined Power targeting versus effects and solo gains
checked_claims.detail: Correct shared targeting sites, no shared actual sites for other effects, River-only special site treatment and two independent Major Forgets.

checked_claims.claims: Mantle of Dread, Tidal Boon and Spirit-targeting Fear
checked_claims.detail: Correct choose own land even if incomplete effects, Tidal conditional local to its Push, unspecified Fear has no land.

checked_claims.claims: Lightning, River and Shadows specific clarifications
checked_claims.detail: All stated Air-use, Fear location, disk-count, site-moving, Energy timing, retained Repeat modification and Shadows threshold dependencies checked against individual rulings.

checked_claims.claims: Green and Thunderspeaker specific clarifications
checked_claims.detail: Correct optional Choke, card-based Healthy test, explicit destroyed Presence regeneration, Dahan accompanying Presence and post-Ravage Sworn to Victory loss.

checked_claims.claims: Ocean land status, Growth source, legal Presence and range measurement
checked_claims.detail: Correct limited Coastal Wetland treatment, no ordinary Growth addition to Ocean, Growth may measure from existing Ocean Presence, normal land-type restrictions remain.

checked_claims.claims: Drowning, Fear and Energy trade
checked_claims.detail: Correct any Ocean Presence on board sufficient, only specified Drown effects, Fear upon destruction, printed Health trade with change, no Dahan Energy.

checked_claims.claims: Ocean action-tree persistence, failed Drowning and illegal-piece cleanup
checked_claims.detail: Correct Ocean persists through tree, non-human pieces out of play afterward, failed humans Pushed then cleaned up before outcome check, destroyed-place survivors cleaned up.

checked_claims.claims: Bringer hypothetical Damage and actual-destruction exceptions
checked_claims.detail: Correct 0/2/5 Fear, Explorer/Town Push, no cumulative hypothetical Damage across separate uses, existing real Damage unchanged, real non-Power Damage and indirect destruction allowed.

checked_claims.claims: Call on Midnight’s Dreams Forget and repeat
checked_claims.detail: Correct this Power means original card, ordinary Major Forget can satisfy conditional and forgotten card cannot later use ordinary Repeat permission.

checked_claims.claims: Condensed Player Reference

Dissolve the Bonds: missing Explorer symbol is literal {Explorer}
Setup +1 and no repeated flip addition
Choke the Land optional may correction
Strong exactly 1 means total additional Blight, not per player
2 per player +1 and 5 per player +1 literal quantities
